svg.title: Mercado architecture
svg.desc: Browser, nginx frontend, Spring Cloud Gateway, six Spring Boot services each with its own PostgreSQL database, RabbitMQ commands for the checkout saga, Kafka integration events on shop.events, Server-Sent Events back to the browser and an OpenTelemetry observability stack.
svg.text: Spring Boot 4 · database-per-service · CQRS + event sourcing · saga · transactional outbox
integration events · written through the transactional outbox (event_store → OutboxRelay) · at-least-once · idempotent consumers
